results.definition_en: The quality of having ownership, superior authority, and governing control over a being or thing. In unqualified use it denotes God; in other uses the thing owned or governed is explicitly identified.
To keep something under sustained care, correcting and developing it and bringing it step by step to completion.
A learned person with knowledge of God and religious rulings, who acts wisely and cultivates people from basic knowledge toward more advanced knowledge.
A large group formed by many people coming together, or an association formed when separate tribes unite as one body.

issues.reason: The source supports a stepchild, a stepparent who undertakes care of the child, and a female caregiver, but it does not mention a female animal kept indoors for milk or connect such an animal to this family-care relation.

results.definition_en: A thickened fruit concentrate or the dark sediment of oil; the term also describes leather containers, food, or medicine processed and strengthened by applying or mixing in this substance.

issues.reason: The source refers to the place or station where a camel stays; it does not say that an animal is tied to a mate.

results.definition_en: A cluster of clouds whose parts overlap one another or hang beneath other clouds; it may be white or black.
The newness or freshness of something at its beginning. A recently lambed sheep and the earliest period of youth are specific applications of this recency.
A leather or cloth holder for arrows or lots used in drawing lots or gambling; by extension, the set of arrows collected in it.
An agreement or pledged word that binds people through mutual commitment, security, or solidarity. Those bound by the agreement, and a tax share treated as binding like a pledge, are related uses.
A plant name applied to a soft herb, another plant, or a small tree; some kinds are said to remain green without drying out in summer.
A large or abundant quantity of water gathered in one place; in some uses it is specified as fresh water.
A herd, especially of wild cattle; some uses include a general cattle herd or a camel herd.
A particle that indicates a small number with an indefinite noun. Depending on added elements, a verb may follow and the meaning may approach sometimes.
The same unqualified dictionary form has one of three senses, depending on context, with no common conceptual connection stated: a need, a tight knot, or kindness and help.
A captain who leads and directs the sailors on a ship.

To know or recognize something and apprehend it as it really is, thus emerging from ignorance. Being informed of something, teaching, learning, and prevailing over another in knowledge are uses attached to particular forms that develop from this core.

A conspicuous mark or sign that distinguishes something from others, makes it recognizable, or points the way to it. A flag, a prominent mountain visible from afar, a waymark, a garment edge, and identifying marks added later are different realizations of this function.

All created beings; depending on context, the universe and everything in it or the separate classes of created beings. The idea that this whole points to its creator is given as the explanation for the name.
A distinct cleft in a persons upper lip or in the upper lip area of a camel. The branch also includes a form describing someone with this feature and an action of cleaving the upper lip.
The same lexical form can denote the sea in one use and a well with abundant water in another. These are kept as separate senses rather than merged into a general meaning of a body of water.
A name for a falcon or hawk type of bird of prey. A derived descriptive form from this bird name describes an agile and intelligent man.
A plain animal name for a male hyena.
